reviewMethod: Antigravity drafts separately reviewed against complete archived version bodies and source notes; source discrepancies retained explicitly.

headings.title: Written notice requirements for adverse claim of beneficial interest
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes adverse claimant to give written notice identifying claimant, owner, and issue to corporation or transfer agent prior to transfer.

headings.title: Notice to adverse claimant and thirty-day transfer withholding
headings.reviewNote: Permits mailing notice of presentation to claimant and requires withholding transfer for thirty days unless restrained by court order.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently verified both subsections and source notes (L. 1959 S.B. 241 § 5). Confirmed draft titles for adverse claim written notice requirements and registered/certified mail notice with 30-day transfer withholding.

headings.title: Nonliability of transaction participants and guarantors absent actual knowledge
headings.reviewNote: Shields transaction participants and signature guarantors from breach of fiduciary duty liability absent actual knowledge of wrongful use or breach.

headings.title: Signature guarantor nonliability coextensive with corporation or transfer agent
headings.reviewNote: Relieves signature guarantor of liability on guarantee where corporation or transfer agent incurs no liability under sections 403.250 to 403.350.

headings.title: No imposition of liability on corporation or transfer agent
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that this section does not impose liability upon the corporation or its transfer agent.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently verified all 3 subsections and source notes (L. 1959 S.B. 241 § 7). Confirmed all 3 draft titles for third-person/guarantor nonliability absent actual knowledge, coextensive guarantor protection, and no corporate/transfer-agent liability imposition.

headings.title: Territorial law governing corporation and transfer agent fiduciary transfers
headings.reviewNote: Specifies that rights and duties of corporation and transfer agents in registering or transferring securities are governed by law of jurisdiction of incorporation.

headings.title: Territorial applicability to third-party acts and signature guarantees
headings.reviewNote: Applies sections 403.250 to 403.350 to rights and duties of non-corporation persons and signature guarantors for acts and omissions in Missouri.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently verified both subsections and source notes (L. 1959 S.B. 241 § 8). Confirmed draft titles for jurisdiction-of-incorporation law governing corporation/transfer agent duties and Missouri law governing in-state third-party acts and signature guarantees.
